evaluation.model: Smoothed conditional basket-frequency model with margin-aware ranking and popularity fallback
evaluation.selection_objective: Mean recovered hidden-item training gross margin at rank<=3, equal weight per multi-item order

selected_vs_margin_baseline.interpretation: Offline recovered-item margin proxy only; not incremental sales or randomized treatment evidence

selected_vs_popularity.interpretation: Offline recovered-item margin proxy only; not incremental sales or randomized treatment evidence

caveats: Dataset already explored; chronological isolation is computational, not a newly untouched confirmation set
Masked basket completion conditions on items already purchased and cannot estimate incremental upsell
No verified purchase sequence within orders
Unit economics fixed from Jan-Mar; availability is a manual scenario input
Aggregate regular-customer context is not individual personalization
No layout or customer movement outcomes observed
